summary.text: A child born in Singapore is automatically a Singapore Citizen if either parent is a Singapore citizen at birth.

details.heading: When citizenship is automatic
details.body: The child is automatically a Singapore Citizen if the child was born in Singapore and either parent was a Singapore citizen when the child was born. The parents must be legally married.

example_phrasings: How do I check my newborn's citizenship status?
Is my newborn automatically a Singapore Citizen?
When is a newborn a Singapore Citizen?

sources.page_title: How do I check my newborn's citizenship status?

quotes.text: A child born in Singapore to legally married parents who are both Singapore citizens (or either one is a Singapore citizen) at the time of child's birth, is automatically a Singapore Citizen.
